question: M1 Max 32GB unified memory 27B model quantization support

sources.title: TMax 27B on MacBook Pro M1 Max 32GB: TIGHT FIT, ~11 tok/s
sources.snippet: On MacBook Pro M1 Max 32GB, TMax 27B can safely use up to 55K tokens of context. The model's official context limit is 262K, but available memory constrains the safe maximum.

sources.title: Apple M1 Max (32-64 GB VRAM): Which LLMs Can It Run?
sources.snippet: Apple M1 Max ships in 32-64 GB unified-memory configurations (LPDDR5) at 400 GB/s. Runs Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 120B-A12B at Q2_K and Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B (MoE) at Q8_0 natively. See every compatible LLM per configuration with quantization options and tokens/sec estimates.
